answer_1.quote: We collect human subject data using Amazon Mechanical Turk... participants sequentially see 15 dialogs... Four questions are asked on a 5-point Likert scale... The first question asks whether "The response R gave would be POSSIBLE for R to truthfully say"...
answer_1.outputs: Possible/impossible and comfort ratings for robot utterances; classifier predictions; generated dialog responses

answer_4.quote: We collect human subject data using Amazon Mechanical Turk... Four questions are asked on a 5-point Likert scale... The first question asks whether "The response R gave would be POSSIBLE for R to truthfully say"... Questions three and four ask if the participant is comfortable with the response.
answer_4.guideline: Four Likert-scale questions: (1) robot possible, (2) human possible, (3) comfortable with robot response, (4) comfortable with human response
